output.summary: Arts' gap is mostly SlotBook tickets (42% of tickets) routed to the unstaffed-in-practice P4 queue (70% of the gap), plus Lindqvist's twice-weekly on-site cover for hardware. Arts non-SlotBook tickets match like-for-like with other faculties, so deprioritisation, trivial tickets and a duplicate-ticket problem are contradicted. The generic ACK-P4 email never told requesters about the best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unresolved: only an unrecorded meeting exists. The SSO link to the September rise is confounded by the term start. Best next steps are to agree SlotBook's support status in writing, fix the acknowledgement and report monthly. Moving to CampusBook, an Arts-run desk or putting all Arts tickets on P4 is not justified.
